description: This file defines the FC3_Firstboot class, a subclass of KickstartCommand, which manages the configuration of the firstboot setup agent in a Red Hat-based system. It includes methods for parsing command-line options and generating configuration output related to firstboot behavior.

classes.name: FC3_Firstboot
classes.description: A class that manages the firstboot configuration command for Red Hat systems, allowing enabling, disabling, or reconfiguring the setup agent at first boot.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the FC3_Firstboot object, setting up the parser and firstboot state.

methods.name: __str__
methods.description: Generates the string representation of the command based on the current firstboot setting.

methods.name: _getParser
methods.description: Creates and returns an option parser for the firstboot command-line options.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses command-line arguments to set the firstboot configuration.
